options.option: Reuse a stable provider-enforced idempotency key for every attempt of the same logical webhook event.
options.tradeoff: Simplest delivery-side behavior when the provider guarantees idempotency, but requires verified provider support and stable key persistence.

options.option: Maintain a durable local delivery ledger and reconcile ambiguous outcomes before or during retry.
options.tradeoff: Does not depend entirely on provider idempotency, but adds persistence, concurrency control, retention, and recovery complexity.

options.option: Explicitly retain at-least-once delivery and require webhook consumers to deduplicate.
options.tradeoff: Keeps the producer simpler but transfers correctness risk to every consumer and requires an approved compatibility commitment plus a documented stable event identifier.
